cachetools-423-attempt1-failed.json.lesson: A mistyped file-block closing marker lost the file three times. The parser now accepts a wrong or missing marker.

cachetools-423-attempt2-failed.json.lesson: The model rewrote a 500-line file from a 40-line excerpt and destroyed the module. Edits are now targeted, and big-file overwrites are refused.

cachetools-423-attempt3-failed.json.lesson: A garbled edit was read as an empty replacement and deleted a method. Edits use SEARCH/REPLACE and are refused if unreadable.

cachetools-423-attempt4-solved-but-messy.lesson: Solved, but five scratch files shipped in the patch and Tavily returned a pest-control page. Scratch files are excluded; Tavily searches developer sources.

cachetools-423-attempt5-failed.json.lesson: The model put edit markers inside JSON, then read whole files (328k tokens). JSON-field edits are understood; reads are capped.

cachetools-423.json.lesson: Clean two-file pull request: a 2-line fix and a test. The upstream test passes.

cachetools-423-attempt7-failed-with-docs.lesson: Re-run after adding the official-documentation lookup (Super only, 14 steps, $0.053). Not solved: one run proves little, and we claim no effect of the lookup on the fix rate.
